CREATE FUNCTION dbo.order_total(@customer_id INT) RETURNS DECIMAL(10,2) AS BEGIN RETURN 0 END
CREATE FUNCTION sales.top_lines(@n INT) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN SELECT TOP (@n) * FROM sales.[Order Lines]
